newsitem.title: USA: First Mutual sets stock buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: First Mutual sets stock buyback plan.

text.p: First Mutual Bancorp Inc said its board has authorized the repurchase of up to 235,000 common shares of the company.
The shares to be bought back represents about 6.3 percent of its current oustanding common stock, the company said.

Paul Reynolds, president and chief executive officer of the company, said the repurchase will be carried out through open market transactions, but did not rule out the possibility of unsolicited negotiated transactions or other types of purchases.
No shares will be bought back from directors or officers of the company, he added.
